entities.name: Ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: Catalyzes formation of 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) from D-ribose 5-phosphate and ATP, producing AMP and proton; EC 2.7.6.1, Rhea RHEA:15609.

Reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic and participate in PRPP biosynthesis, purine nucleotide biosynthesis, and ribonucleoside monophosphate biosynthesis.
